lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white line segments. Spacing is widest on the anterior torso (shoulders) and progressively narrows toward the posterior (rump) where curvature increases.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fifth line from the anterior, splitting approximately one-third of the way down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The final three lines on the posterior haunch are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso without extending to the ventral or dorsal boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 6-8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper-lateral quadrant of the hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal crescent marking on the lower throat; two distinct white spots visible on the lateral muzzle area.
